author: jherng
description: Dataset for the paper "Not only Look, but also Listen: Learning Multimodal Violence Detection under Weak Supervision". The dataset is downloaded from the authors' website (https://roc-ng.github.io/XD-Violence/). Hosting this dataset on HuggingFace is just to make it easier for my own project to use this dataset. Please cite the original paper if you use this dataset.
